findings.title: 1 accelerator node has no node health detection: bad nodes keep getting work
evidence: no node-problem-detector, no EKS node monitoring agent, and every node condition is one of the kubelet's five

fix.summary: First option: keep GKE node auto-repair on for the accelerator pools (it repairs nodes whose GPU device or driver fails). Otherwise install node-problem-detector as the stack's node_health, with a kernel-log rule that sets GPUProblem on a fatal NVIDIA Xid.

findings.title: 1 workload runs accelerators with the 64 MiB /dev/shm default
evidence: Job/research/train: 1 pod, container trainer mounts no memory emptyDir at /dev/shm

fix.summary: Mount an emptyDir {medium: Memory} (with a sizeLimit) at /dev/shm in each accelerator container: NCCL, PyTorch DataLoader workers and vLLM's tensor parallelism need more than 64 MiB.

findings.title: Image volumes are unavailable: weights cannot be mounted from an OCI artifact without a sidecar
evidence: API server v1.31.2-gke.1000: the ImageVolume feature gate is on by default from Kubernetes 1.35

fix.summary: Upgrade to Kubernetes 1.35+ with containerd 2.1+ to mount weights as an image volume. Until then, KServe's modelcar sidecar or an init-container copy is the fallback.
